title: Money Mod
description: Minecraft mod money mod for Arabic
body:
A comprehensive economic mod adds a sophisticated currency system to the game, giving players new ways to trade and interact within servers and survival worlds.



Players can sell items for money and easily transfer funds between each other using simple and fast commands, helping to create a real economy within the world.



The mod focuses on providing a smooth and lightweight experience without complications, with automatic data saving to ensure that balances and important information are not lost, even after a server restart.



It is an ideal choice for survival, economy, and roleplay servers, as it adds extra objectives and encourages players to gather resources and trade with each other.



✅ Compatible with Fabric



✅ Supports Minecraft versions 1.20.1 to 1.20.6



✅ Easy to use and lightweight

✅ Currency system and player transfers
